title: card one inner link hit area
name: Card one inner link hit area
rule: Card: one inner link; hit-area wraps the card. Do not wrap the whole card in `<a>` (screen readers announce the entire contents; the links landmark becomes unusable). Keep a large click target via CSS hit-area on a single inner anchor. Dual-cite USWDS “card is an action, not a frame.”
pass_when: One inner `<a>`; CSS hit-area makes the card clickable; the card itself is not the `<a>`.
fail_when: The whole card is wrapped in `<a>`, or multiple competing links sit in the card without a single inner-anchor pattern.
overview: Cards use one inner link with a CSS hit-area; do not wrap the whole card in an anchor.
apply_when: Cards act as links or primary navigation targets.
not_when: Non-linked informational cards with no click-through action.
agent_hint: Use one inner anchor plus CSS hit-area; never wrap the whole card in <a>.
description: A card should have one inner link; the hit-area wraps the card via CSS. Do not wrap the whole card in `<a>` — screen readers announce the entire contents and the links landmark becomes unusable. Dual-cite USWDS “card is an action, not a frame.” Pass when one inner `<a>` plus CSS hit-area makes the card clickable without the card itself being the `<a>`; fail when the whole card is wrapped in `<a>` or multiple competing links break the single inner-anchor pattern.
do_not_claim: USWDS “card is an action” as a merge that drops the inner-anchor + landmark fail.
